text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's partial-response/timeouts blip. Need owners, short deadlines, and a weekly check for recurrence patterns. I'll split into 4 tracks: handshake/backoff, SDK reconnects, telemetry/dashboards, runbook/SLOs.

Sam: Taking handshake/backoff + server guard. Plan: add idempotent handshake token + exponential backoff with jitter and a server queue-length backpressure flag. Aim: PR in 48h, canary next week.

Leo: Obs owner. Will add metrics: stream.handshakes, stream.reconnects, stream.partial_chunks (tags: model, route, region) and a 1% sampled streaming trace via header x-rw-stream-sample. Dashboard skeleton in 3 days.

Toni: SDK + tests. Adding reconnectStrategy config (exp/linear/disabled) and a reconnect simulator for CI. Target SDK PR by next Wed; CI job ci/stream-reconnect will run simulator.

Eva: Runbook & SLOs. Propose alerts: warn at partials >0.15% over 15m, page at >0.5% sustained 30m. Draft runbook + rollback steps by Thursday.

deploy-bot: Created INC-5001 handshake-backoff (assignee: Sam).
deploy-bot: Created INC-5002 streaming-telemetry (assignee: Leo).
deploy-bot: Created INC-5003 sdk-reconnect-sim (assignee: Toni).
deploy-bot: Created INC-5004 partial-response-runbook (assignee: Eva).

Sam: Will include p50/p95/p99 handshake latency before/after and a smoke check (handshake success >99.5%) for canary.

Leo: Need two trace ids from the incident to validate joins. Maya: can you DM them? Also adding a small event topic stream.events with event_type + trace_id to join logs quickly.

Maya: Sent two trace ids and added to the ticket. OK to enable 1% sampling for 48-72h during the debug window.

Toni: SDK will negotiate reconnect capability in handshake for backwards compatibility. Old clients default to disabled.

Eva: Scheduling a 30m sync next Thursday 10:00 PT to review canary readiness and dashboard coverage. Post daily 1-2 line updates to the incident doc until closure.

Maya: Thanks everyone, please keep updates short in the ticket. If you need infra or extra oncall during canary ping me. :thumbsup:
